title: WPSS/660/2020 of SHOBHA RANI Vs DIRECTOR GENERAL MEDICAL HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPSS No. 660 of 2020
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Via Video Conferencing)
Mr. C.D. Bahuguna, Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. Anup Kumar Verma,
Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. P.C. Bisht and Mrs. Anjali
Bhargava, Standing Counsel for the State of
Uttarakhand.
The petitioner, who was appointed as
Staff Nurse, was posted at C.H.C., Ghandiyal,
Pauri Garhwal, which is a durgam area, as
back as on 13th September, 2004. Later on,
she had been transferred to various places, and
ultimately, the petitioner was promoted on the
post of Sister on 15th October, 2018. and was
posted, at Government Base Hospital,
Srinagar Garhwal. Later on in the year 2018,
she was detected to be suffering from cancer
in urinary bladder, hence, the petitioner
moved a representation / application to the
respondents for posting her services at a
convenient place, owing to the medial
grounds. Consequently, the respondents
considering the representation of the
petitioner, had sympathetically considered the
same and posted the petitioner at L.D. Bhatt
Government Hospital Kashipur, Udham Singh
Nagar.
The respondent No.1 transferred the
petitioner and attachment was made on
11.12.2018 to the Female Govt. Hospital
Haldwani.
The petitioner raising her grievance
with regard to the suitable posting to be made
at Kashipur, itself, hence had preferred Writ
Petition, being Writ Petition No. 1822 if 2019,
which was disposed of by the Coordinate
Bench of this Court by the judgment dated 31st

July, 2019, directing the respondents to take a
decision on the representation of the petitioner
as submitted on 5th July, 2019.
The respondents, in compliance thereof,
considered the representation and decided the
same by an order dated 5th September, 2019,
whereby, it was observed that her posting at
Kashipur, at that point of time could not be
possible for the reason being that the post,
which she was carrying at that point of time,
there existed no vacancy. It was further
observed in the said order, while deciding the
representation, that whenever the vacancy is
made available, her claim of shifting to
Kashipur in the light of the direction issued by
the Court in its judgment dated 31st July,
2019, would be taken into consideration.
The petitioner has filed this Writ
Petition contending thereof specifically that
the post of Sister, on which, she has to be
adjusted, has now fallen vacant, because one
of the Sisters Mrs. Savita Gupta; had now
attained the age of superannuation on 31st
January, 2020, and consequent thereto, on
occurrence of the vacancy, the petitioner had
submitted the representation on 7th February,
2020, requesting to be posted as against the
said post. She further contended that there is
another vacancy, which has been created on
account of promotion of Sister Smt.
Madhurika Borison, who has been promoted
as Matron thereafter.
Agitating her grievance and in the light
of the decision taken on the representation by
the respondent No.1 on 5th September, 2019,
she yet again reiterated her claim for being
posted at Kashipur and submitted the
representation on 6th July, 2020, in the light of
her chronic ailment.

In the light of the aforesaid
development, which had subsequently taken
place after the decision of 5th September,
2019, whereby, according to the petitioner,
now there exists two vacancies of Sister, as
against which the petitioner could be posted as
the decision on representation dated
05.09.2019.
Considering the ailment, which she is
suffering from, it is hereby directed that
respondent No.1 would reconsider the
representation dated 6th July, 2020, in the light
of the decision earlier taken by him on 5th
September, 2019, and pass an appropriate
order within a period of four weeks from the
date of presentation of certified copy of this
order, for providing suitable posting to the
petitioner.
Subject to the aforesaid observations,
the Writ Petition stands disposed of.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 10.07.2020
Shiv
